title: Pro-Pashinyan support rally during rival demonstrations
reason: The report identifies several hundred people staging a pro-Pashinyan rally but records no demand directed at the Armenian government or state policy; available evidence describes support for the incumbent rather than an anti-state demand.
notes: Not treated as an eligible anti-state mobilization without evidence of a qualifying government-directed demand. This is not an inference that the event was small; RFE/RL reports several hundred participants.
